name: MDMAR
summary: 3',4'-Methylenedioxy-4-methylaminorex (MDMAR) is a recreational designer drug from the substituted aminorex family, with monoamine-releasing effects. It is a potent serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA).

pharmacology.text: It is a potent serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA).

uses.text: 3',4'-Methylenedioxy-4-methylaminorex (MDMAR) is a recreational designer drug from the substituted aminorex family, with monoamine-releasing effects.

summaryZh: MDMAR是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C11H12N2O3，屬於阿米雷司衍生物。
summaryZhHans: MDMAR是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C11H12N2O3，属于阿米雷司衍生物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related aminorex drugs, which release serotonin, dopamine and noradrenaline, have caused a racing heart, overheating and agitation, and a close relative, 4,4'-DMAR, has been linked to many deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。會釋放血清素、多巴胺與正腎上腺素的相關阿米雷司類藥物曾造成心跳過快、體溫過高與躁動，近親 4,4'-DMAR 更與許多死亡案例有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。会释放血清素、多巴胺与正肾上腺素的相关阿米雷司类药物曾造成心跳过快、体温过高与躁动，近亲 4,4'-DMAR 更与许多死亡案例有关。

fact.en: MDMAR joins the methylenedioxy ring of MDMA to the aminorex skeleton of 4-methylaminorex, a stimulant once sold on the street as U4Euh.
fact.zh: MDMAR 把 MDMA 的亞甲二氧基環接到4-甲基阿米雷司的骨架上，後者是一種曾以「U4Euh」之名在街頭販售的興奮劑。
fact.zhHans: MDMAR 把 MDMA 的亚甲二氧基环接到4-甲基阿米雷司的骨架上，后者是一种曾以「U4Euh」之名在街头贩售的兴奋剂。
